userStories.title: Fix round-specific points in mock roster hooks
userStories.description: As a league member, I want my roster page to show only the points earned during the current round so that R1 points don't contaminate R2 displays.
acceptanceCriteria: useMockRoster and useMockLeagueRosters compute points_earned using getRoundDateBounds(slot.round) — only counting stats between firstDate and min(simulationDate, lastDate) for that round

Refactor to reuse calculateRoundMemberPoints from utils.ts instead of duplicating calculation logic — remove the standalone calculatePlayerPoints and calculateGoaliePoints helpers from useMockRoster.ts
R1 roster slots show only R1 game points; R2 slots show only R2 game points, etc.
Standings page (calculateMemberPoints in utils.ts) continues to show correct cumulative totals — verify no regression with existing unit tests

userStories.notes: Root cause: calculatePlayerPoints and calculateGoaliePoints in useMockRoster.ts (lines 79-116) only filter by throughDate (upper bound) but have no fromDate. calculateRoundMemberPoints in utils.ts already does this correctly with both bounds. Import getRoundDateBounds from MockDataProvider.tsx and calculateRoundMemberPoints from utils.ts. For each slot, get bounds via getRoundDateBounds(slot.round), compute throughDate as min(simulationDate, bounds.lastDate), skip if simulationDate < bounds.firstDate.
